## Experience
- EDVORA (2026–present): Founder & Product Designer. Took a multi-tenant SaaS for Indonesian training centres (LPK) sending participants to Japan from research to launch-ready (5 delivery phases, 319 automated tests).
- Funnelish, London (2024–2026): Senior Product Designer, remote. Funnelish AI (funnels generated on demand), checkout and Smart Payment Routing, funnel store redesign while users grew 845 to 3,000+, Figma design tokens.
- top.legal, Germany (2024): Senior Product Designer, contract. AI contract assistant that flags risky clauses inside the document; UI for long German text.
- SEVIMA, Indonesia (2023–2024): Senior Product Designer. Design system with Figma tokens and code-ready components (+30% production quality); academic ERP; university leadership dashboard.
- Talentvis, Singapore (2018–2023): Senior UI/UX Designer, remote. Website redesign (+40% Gen Z sign-ups); talent dashboard for five divisions.
- SKYSHI Digital (2016–2018): UI/UX Designer. Early version of ruparupa.com (Kawan Lama Group).

## Skills
Product UX, complex workflows, information architecture, data-rich dashboards, e-commerce checkout and payment UX, design systems and tokens, AI product design, user research, prototyping (including coded prototypes), Figma, design handoff.
